siteSubtitle: A classical Chinese dream book, read in plain language
heroSub: Describe it in your own words. The answer comes from a dream book compiled in China more than a thousand years ago.
askPlaceholder: For example: I dreamed I was swimming in a river and a snake came out of the water…

example2: I dreamed I was falling from a very tall building
example3: I dreamed I lost all my teeth
example4: I dreamed of being chased by someone with a knife

sourceText: The passages above come from 周公解夢, a collection of Chinese dream interpretations built up over many centuries and published under the name of the Duke of Zhou. It is not scientific and does not predict the future; it is a record of what people long ago believed their dreams meant, and it is still a good way to notice what your own mind is working on.
disclaimer: For reflection and entertainment. Not a prediction, not medical or psychological advice.
aboutText: The whole book is about 12,000 characters, so it ships as a plain data file and is searched directly on your device — no database, no vector search. Your question is matched against the book locally, the closest passages are shown, and an AI model then explains those passages in your own language.
